Sample Name*.1: Give the sample a name that is meaningful to you. Sample names must be unique across all JGI projects and contain ASCII characters only.

Biological replicate/sample group Name*.1: Samples that are biological replicates should have the same group name.  If your project does not contain biological replicates, give each sample its own group name.

Strain or cultivar*.1: Strain or cultivar of the organism

Culture Collection and ID.1: If applicable, please list the culture collection name and ID here. The data must consist of both letters and numbers.

NCBI Tax ID* (required for bacteria, arc.1: Unique identifier from the NCBI taxonomy database.

Reference Genome* (required for resequen.1: Reference to be used for analysis.
Reference Genome* (required for resequen.2: Escherichia coli K-12 MG1655; IMG taxon OID 646311926

Host NCBI Taxonomy ID* (required for vir.1: Unique identifier for the viral host, from the NCBI taxonomy database.

Concentration* (ng/ul).1: Must be calculated using a fluorometric method; value >0 and <2000.

Volume* (ul).1: Value must be >0 and <1000 (values <25 by special permission only).

Tube or Plate Label*.1: Must be unique across all tubes and plates, and <20 characters.  All samples in a plate should have the same plate label.

Plate location (well #)* required if sam.1: Corner wells must be blank. For partial plates, fill by columns. Leave blank if the sample will be shipped in a tube.

Sample Format*.1: Choose from the following: Pellet, Ethanol, MDA Reaction Buffer, PBS, TE, Water, Low EDTA TE, 10 mM Tris-HCl, Gentegra-DNA, Gentegra-RNA

Was Sample DNAse treated?*.1: Y/N.  Note DNAse treatment is required for all RNA samples.

For fungal draft samples, was 16S screen.1: Y/N.  Note 16S screening is required for all fungal draft samples.

For fungal draft samples, does ITS match.1: Y/N.  Note All fungal draft samples require an ITS match in the UNITE database to verify taxonomy..

Is the sample isolated from a single col.1: Y/N.  Was the sample isolated from an axenic/strain pure culture?

Known / Suspected Organisms.1: List any organisms known or suspected to grow in co-culture or that may be contaminating the culture, as well as an estimate of the % of the organism in that culture.

First ribosomal sequence* (required for.1:
At least one ribosomal sequence is required for strain verification and must come from the actual sample to be shipped to JGI.  Please use only A, C, G, T or N, with no header.  Sequence of insufficient quality may delay the completion of the project. 16s sequence is required for all microbial drafts and single cells.  For microbial drafts, sequence MUST be >1300 nt; for single cells the sequence MUST be >220 bp, with <10% Ns. 
ITS sequence is required for all samples for fungal drafts for strain verification. ITS sequence must be >450 nt with <2% Ns.

First ribosomal sequence comments.1: Required only if "other" is selected as type.

Second ribosomal sequence.1: Other types of ribosomal sequence may be provided as a secondary check.  Sequence MUST come from the actual sample to be shipped to JGI.  For 28s, the sequence must be >300 nt with <10% Ns. Please use only A, C, G, T or N, with no header.

Second ribosomal sequence comments.1: Required only if "other" is selected as type.

Biosafety Material Category*.1: Choose from the following values: Alga, Animal, Archaea, Bacteria, Fungi, Plant, Plasmid, Protist, Virus, Synthetic Construct.

Sample Isolation Method*.1: Describe the method/protocol/kit used to extract DNA/RNA.

Collection Year*.1: Year in which the sample was collected. More details on the "instructions" tab.

Collection Month*.1: Month in which the sample was collected. Use the full name of the month. More details on the "instructions" tab.

Collection Day*.1: Day on which the sample was collected. More details on the "instructions" tab.

Collection Site or Growth Conditions* (r.1: Provide information on the specific tissue type or growth conditions.
